opportunity.title: Sizing Technology Pilot (Army Call for Solutions)
opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Call for Solutions under Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002)
opportunity.description: Army Contracting Command-Aberdeen Proving Ground, on behalf of HQDA G-4, seeks mature commercial technology that captures body and foot measurements by automated non-contact methods and translates them into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Current manual tape measurement at accession points causes bottlenecks and high uniform and boot return rates and keeps no record of sizing changes over time. Evaluation phases and required attributes are in Attachment 1. Questions were due Oct 13 2026. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: The opportunity is open to large businesses (set-aside NONE) and matches the company's NAICS 541512, with place of performance ANY and deadline passed per eligibility gate.

The solicitation seeks mature commercial technology for automated body/foot measurement, which may not align with the company's core IT services portfolio (541511, 541512, 541519, 541330) unless they have or can acquire such a product.
Estimated value ($100K–$500K) is well below the company's typical prime contract range ($5M–$60M), raising questions about return on bid investment.

risks: Low contract value relative to company size and overhead
Potential technology gap: solicitation calls for a specific commercial product, not general IT services
Tight timeline: questions due Oct 13, 2026; response due Oct 20, 2026
nextSteps: Assess whether the company has or can partner with a vendor offering mature automated body/foot measurement technology
Evaluate strategic value of entering Army uniform/footwear sizing domain for potential follow-on work
Calculate bid cost vs. expected value and probability of win

classification.summary: The Army needs a mature commercial technology that automatically measures body and foot dimensions without contact to generate recommended uniform and footwear sizes, eliminating manual tape measurements and reducing bottlenecks and return rates.
